priorityDecision: Do not add another visual assembly before proving that the immediately preceding grass-blade upgrade is actually persisted into the canonical scene used by formal native-4K evidence. Source audit found that QualityBlock4KCapture.PrepareSceneForSynchronizedCapture reopens the canonical scene, while QualityBlockGrassBladeFieldUpgrade's scene-open convenience path calls ApplyToOpenScene(false). That can create a renderable in-memory GrassBladeFieldDetail after reopen without explicitly persisting that newly generated hierarchy into the scene evidence state. Closing that gap has higher expected gate value than speculative expansion because the intended vegetation improvement must first survive into valid evidence.

changes.summary: Machine-readable fail-closed contract requiring the canonical scene-open path to persist deterministic grass, record a latest scene-saved grass fingerprint baseline, keep render callbacks read-only, and require QualityCamera/reflection/still/temporal culls to match that baseline. Runtime render verification remains false and Visual Fidelity award remains zero.

InitializeOnLoad scene-open/save/formal-pre-cull integration. On canonical scene open, once the generated grass source material and contracts exist, the existing deterministic grass builder is invoked with persist=true. Every canonical scene save records a SHA-256 fingerprint over grass hierarchy transforms, mesh asset/dependency identity, renderer/material live PBR state and LOD assignments. Formal camera pre-cull is read-only and fails if current grass differs from the latest saved fingerprint or if no saved baseline exists. Temporary benchmark-camera transforms do not invalidate the grass-specific baseline.

implementationReadiness.reason: The run closes a source-side evidence persistence gap but cannot earn the missing 7-point Unity compile/runtime verification without an actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner.

expectedScoreImpact: Vegetation/natural complexity: preserves the already-implemented physical grass silhouette layer in the saved scene actually used for evidence; medium evidence-value improvement, not a pixel score.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: binds formal temporal culls to the latest saved grass LOD/render state; small-medium evidence-value improvement, no points until motion pixels are reviewed.

Critical-defect review: reduces provenance ambiguity when judging primitive fallback, repeated grass structure, floating/interpenetrating lawn detail and visible LOD pop; it does not auto-clear any critical defect.
Direct rendered appearance change from this run: none; automatic Visual Fidelity impact is 0.
